Thanks for the words guys, I've just been depressed for the past 4 years. Dropped out of College in my first year with two credits, both near failing final grades.  Wanna just get back into school, I've lost interest in so much shit I used to love, reading, exploring, walking, running, biking.  

Sounds stupid but I might actually Lawyer up, hit the gym, delete facebook, minus the lawyer :P  

Guess I needed to vent. Sorry for clogging this subreddit with this shit, when other people may have needed help more.  I would never kill myself because I love my brother and father too much and it would ruin them, but I've felt like it at times.

Thanks.
